_help: Act 7, the confrontation with the thieves (from act7_intercept). Americans: with sky_dark and Whitfield's trust >= 2 he yields; he'll also sell for 100 (bought_artifacts). Germans: with sky_dark and Adler's trust >= 2 he yields; with stones_falling Vogel overrules him. Italians: no friendship, but with sickness Sofia Ricci turns Bellini. Otherwise event fight_thieves (end_fight; when won, act7.gd sets artifacts_recovered and starts act7_recovered). Peaceful: artifacts_recovered + recovered_peacefully (end_recovered). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

t_americans.speaker: whitfield
t_americans.line: Well, look who it is. Pal, I'd love to chat, but my boat's leaving and I've got a cargo to sell.

choices.label: Point at the sky
choices.line: Look up, Charlie. That's your cargo doing that.

choices.label: Buy them back
choices.line: Name your price for the jars and the amulet.

am_yield.speaker: whitfield
am_yield.line: ...Yeah. Yeah, I've been looking at it all week. Red, put the guns down. Give him the crates. I'm a lot of things, pal, but I'm not the end of the world.

am_refuse.speaker: whitfield
am_refuse.line: Weather's weather. I didn't come all this way to go home with a sunburn and a story.

am_buy.speaker: whitfield
am_buy.line: A hundred pounds, and you can have the whole cursed lot. I'll even throw in the crates.

choices.label: Take them
choices.line: I'm not paying you for stolen goods.

am_paid.speaker: whitfield
am_paid.line: Pleasure doing business. Now get them out of my sight.

t_germans.speaker: adler
t_germans.line: I know why you have come. These objects belong in a museum, where they can be studied properly. Not back under the sand.

choices.label: Point at the sky
choices.line: Professor, look outside. Study that, if you can.

choices.label: Appeal to Vogel
choices.line: Vogel. You're the one who counts the dead. Count what's coming.

ge_yield.speaker: adler
ge_yield.line: ...I have watched it for three days and called it a sandstorm. You are right, and I am a stubborn old man. Wilhelm, open the trunk.

ge_refuse.speaker: adler
ge_refuse.line: A remarkable phenomenon. It changes nothing about where these objects belong.

ge_vogel.speaker: vogel
ge_vogel.line: Herr Professor. Stones are falling on children in the street. Give it to him, or I will.

ge_vogel_end.speaker: adler
ge_vogel_end.line: Ernst! ...Very well. Very well. Take them, and may you be right about all of it.

t_italians.speaker: bellini
t_italians.line: Ah. The famous expedition leader. You found the tomb; I found the buyers. That is how it goes in our business.

choices.label: Appeal to Sofia
choices.line: Signorina Ricci, you know what these are. You know what's happening.

it_sky.speaker: bellini
it_sky.line: I see clouds. I also see a buyer in Genoa with a great deal of money.

it_sofia.speaker: sofia
it_sofia.line: Vittorio. People are dying in the streets. I won't be paid in that money. Give it to him.

it_yield.speaker: bellini
it_yield.line: ...Bah. There is no business in a dead city. Take your curse, and take it far away from me.

fight.speaker: player
fight.line: Hands go to holsters on both sides.

recovered.speaker: player
recovered.line: The jars, four of them, sealed again with wax. And the amulet, a gold eye, warm to the touch.
